captions_note: the reel's captions stay on: the cards sit on clear background beside or above the speaker. If build.py puts a card over the body where the caption band is, add fewer or shorter cards, or hide the reel captions for the slot (--hide-captions a-b)
in_a_reel: keep GRADE = 'none' (the reel owns the look)
cards come on at IN_F at the earliest and everything is gone 6 frames before the slot ends, so both edges are the plain picture. Each card needs 1 s on screen
card text is the buyer's own words for the things they name in the clip: no number, result or claim they do not say
steps: run track.py      # measure the head, the tie points, the open space and the word starts (about 30 s); read what it prints
edit the CLIP block in build.py, then build with the guide on; a line starting with !! is a stop or a warning to act on
hf snapshot --at 3.6,4.5      # snapshot 0.6 s after the last card lands and 0.5 s before the end (seconds; build.py prints the landing frames)
run build.py      # build without the guide, then render
run check.py      # numbers, sheet, lock crops, stills, phone copy
